purpose: Replay the small, durable controls that prevent known false media states while leaving canonical data mutation and projection regeneration to an exact-current-main transaction.

source_commits.message: fix(test): make canonical gate portable on Windows

Resolve the repository root with fileURLToPath so Windows drive-letter paths remain valid.
Require every enforced second-desk or owner media ruling to carry at least one evidence receipt. Also retain deterministic first-match scope selection for later sitewide replay.

Prove that evidence-free enforced votes fail closed, evidenced enforced votes remain valid, first-match Star Trek scope wins, and non-Star-Trek records enter the fallback scope when that scope is activated.

validation.claim: The repository collection-policy and archive-contract workflows passed on the exact four-file code head. These workflows do not substitute for the complete canonical gate required after source corrections and projection regeneration.

remove or replace any existing evidence-free enforced votes

prove current-main and live deployment state
